summary_1line: After killing the demon Maricha, Rama hurries back to the hermitage, troubled by ominous portents and fearing Sita has been harmed.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama runs through the forest with bow in hand while jackals howl behind him and dark birds circle ominously overhead.
Rama grasps Lakshmana’s left hand in distress, reproaching him for leaving Sita alone in the demon-haunted forest.
Pale-faced Lakshmana approaches through the woods as Rama watches anxiously, surrounded by beasts and birds crying ill omens.
